name: Seamtec Scraper
short_desc: Scraper for the Seamtec SCADA web UI
author: EckPhi
description: Read-only scraper for the Seamtec SCADA web UI (scc.seamtec.net). Includes a dashboard and form-based configuration editor with validation, connectivity tests, persistent Save, and runtime Apply without a restart. Emits datapoints to stdout, QuestDB/InfluxDB line protocol, MQTT, or Telegraf HTTP.

form_fields.label: Config file
form_fields.hint: /config/seamtec.toml is the editable Weissenberg+QuestDB config in app-data/data/config/ (default). The image itself ships only a placeholder config.toml without facility data.

form_fields.label: Sink override
form_fields.hint: Leave empty to use the sinks from the config file (recommended; the default config writes to the QuestDB app). Set e.g. stdout or ilp:host:9009 to override.

form_fields.label: Failure notification URLs
form_fields.hint: Optional comma-separated apprise URLs, e.g. tgram://bottoken/chatid.
